newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bearish mood take Bucharest share prices down.
newsitem.headline: Bearish mood take Bucharest share prices down.

text.p: Bearish sentiment pushed the average price of most Bucharest stocks lower on Friday and brokers predicted further lows next week.
"You could feel the bearish mood looming over the market for some time and it settled in today," one trader said.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, fell by 2.5 and 3.15 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index was 4.28 percent lower at 2,945.51 points.

Turnover thinned to 6.06 billion lei from 7.9 billion on Thursday as trading grew quieter in typical end-of-the-week fashion. Traders said some of the stocks managed to close higher thanks to deals made towards the end of trading.
"The bearish mood, which follows a period of price surges, will not let go of the market that easily," said one trader.
The first tier had command of the market with 83 percent of turnover, but saw weaker volumes of 1.6 million shares, compared to two million the previous day.
Terapia pharmaceuticals company was the top tier's only stock to gain on its closing quote in last-minute deals. It ended 50 lei firmer at 5,950.

The other three first-tier listings had lower average as well as closing prices. Azomures fertiliser maker shed 300 lei to 3,000, Oltchim chemical plant was 200 weaker at 2,400 and Antibiotice pharmaceuticals firm ended 650 lei down at 4,850.
Policolor was the leading performer on the second tier, with turnover of 918 million lei and a closing quote 50 lei higher at 5,000.
Six second-tier stocks had no trade and two were suspended pending announcements of their economic performance last year.
